en.headline: Police charge Hailey Cheng with four doxxing offences in MediSafe case
en.dek: Officers charged the whistle-blower this morning with four counts of disclosing personal data without consent causing specified harm; the case goes to Eastern Magistrates’ Court this afternoon.
body: Police said on Wednesday that Hailey Cheng Hei-lam has been formally charged with four counts of disclosing personal data of a data subject without consent causing specified harm, in connection with the MediSafe AI prescription platform controversy.

Investigators from the Hong Kong Island Regional Crime Unit allege that Cheng and two unidentified social media users posted doxxing material on Threads, Instagram and Facebook between 16 June and 13 October 2025. The posts allegedly included names, schools, occupations, family photographs, social media accounts and residential addresses of the victims and their relatives, leading to harassment.

Cheng was first arrested on 5 February 2026 after a complaint to the Privacy Commissioner for Personal Data. Police said the case will be brought before the Eastern Magistrates’ Court on Wednesday afternoon. She is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

zh.headline: 藥倍安心風波吹哨者鄭曦琳涉起底罪被控四罪 今午東區裁判法院提堂
zh.dek: 警方周三上午落案起訴鄭曦琳四項「未獲資料當事人同意下披露其個人資料而該披露造成指明傷害」罪，案件今午在東區裁判法院提堂。
body: 警方周三表示，「藥倍安心」人工智能處方平台爭議的吹哨者鄭曦琳已被正式控以四項未獲資料當事人同意下披露個人資料而造成指明傷害的罪名。
港島總區重案組調查指，鄭氏與另外兩名身份未明的社交媒體用戶，在2025年6月16日至10月13日期間，在Threads、Instagram及Facebook發布起底內容，涉及受害人及家屬的姓名、就讀學校、職業、家庭照片、社交媒體帳戶及住址等，導致騷擾。
鄭氏於2026年2月5日因個人資料私隱專員公署接獲投訴後被捕。警方指案件將於周三下午在東區裁判法院提堂。被告在法庭裁定有罪前均被推定無罪。
